text.tspan: * The clock divider will divide the input frequency by 2 when in 1R1T mode, and by 4 in 2R2T mode, to obtain the desired maximum frequency per channel: 61.44MHz.
Register maps on APB (REGMAP_INTERFACE = 1); the IO interface modules use the PolarFire IOD (DDR registers and delay lines); 48b = I0, Q0, I1, Q1 (1R1T: I0, Q0).
